jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT OUR ROLE

The Chief Engineer is responsible for the physical property, maintenance, and engineering operations for Trailborn Jackson Hole.

ABOUT OUR VALUES

We believe in striving for excellence in every interaction, every experience, and every detail — because how we show up each day shapes who we are as a team and the experiences we create for others.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Leadership oversight and Administration of all aspects of the Engineering and Grounds department. Ensuring that the maintenance and repair of facilities operations and construction management activities are meeting all company objectives and requirements within budgetary guidelines. 

Responsible for creation and administration of the department financial plan and management of the approved plan including labor, expenses, and allocations. 

Coordinate Engineering and Grounds activities under the direction of the Assistant General Manager.. Work effectively and cooperatively with all department Directors to ensure all guest service goals are met. This position is a member of the Property Leadership Team.

Maintain professional and credible working relationship outside contractors, and vendors. 

Provide full support for all guest-related maintenance needs. Guest services are a priority. 

Detailed, hands-on planning of all Capital Projects. 

Prepare and maintain a 5-year running Capital Plan for Hotel, Condos and Employee Housing, including, but not limited to recurring improvements such as roofing, painting, and other recurring/cyclic work.

Responsible for the oversight of the administration and execution of all contracts, certificates of insurance and permitting for all projects according to policy and regulation.

Work with the Project manager to ensure each project is successful and timely completed within budget and within the defined Scope of Work.

Plan, develop and implement procedures for all facilities maintenance, repair operations and construction. 

Direct all Engineering and Grounds Department activities focusing on continual improvement and effective asset management.

Plan and implement any/all opening/closing of operational facilities as needed. Ensure that all operations open on time with full services and are closed safely efficiently. 

Lead and supervise the Engineering Manager to ensure that maintenance work orders are being completed in a cost effective, timely and satisfactory manner. Ensure there is no backlog of work orders and that all projects are up to date.

Review and approve all departmental purchase orders and invoices within budget.

Comply with all Federal, State and County regulations, policies and procedures. Comply with all company policies and standards.

Facilitate and document annual departmental refresher trainings with all employees, “Emergency Action Plan procedures.” Conduct weekly and documented safety meetings with staff.

Oversee all timekeeping, scheduling and meal break compliance.

Must be able to demonstrate professional and courteous behavior with all guests and employees.

Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Qualifications:

Minimum 7 to 10 year’s supervisory or foreman experience in general building maintenance, or in trades such as electrical, refrigeration, plumbing, etc.

Must possess, or able to obtain, a valid Driver’s license within 90 days of employment, and comply with Trailborn company vehicle policy.

Preferred Qualifications:

Must have a B.S. or an advanced degree in a related engineering discipline, facilities engineering, construction management, project management, building technology, or seven to ten years of professional equivalent managerial/supervisory level experience.

Established leadership, management and team-building skills. 

Strong commitment to process and change management with the ability to assess department demands and structure, including but limited to strengths, weaknesses and opportunities analyses, and evaluations of roles, responsibilities, and business processes.

Preparation and management of Operational and Capital budget programs. 

Preparation and oversight of construction management program.

Comply with all current related safety and health requirements.

Must possess physical stamina and condition to withstand heavy labor related to work in an extreme outside environment. 

Must be capable of lifting objects weighing up to 50 pounds.

Excellent computer skills including Word, Excel, Outlook, Internet and various engineering software programs.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to effectively handle numerous tasks simultaneously.

Core Competencies:

Able to follow instructions with follow-up, respect and integrity.

Able to provide quick and productive solutions to a multitude of challenges and/or limited resources.

Ability to demonstrate sense urgency around deadlines, guest experience and The Oasis at Death Valley branding. 

Basic Competencies:

High level of professionalism and communication skills (provide clear instructions/directions).

Verbal comprehension (Understand oral and written communications, follow detailed direction).

Attention to Detail skills (minimize the risk of error).

Reasoning skills (problem solving and troubleshooting skills).

Multi-tasking and prioritization skills.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Constantly listening, hearing, seeing, standing, walking, using eye/hand coordination, handling, wrist motion.  

Frequently walk and lift or carry up to 50 lbs.

Occasionally sit, handle, reach outward, reach above shoulder, squat, or kneel, lift/carry and push or pull up to 50 lbs.

Will be required to stand long periods of time and to occasionally walk-up flights of stairs.

Ability to work in extreme temperatures. 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to fingers, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk or hear; and taste or smell. The employee is occasionally required to sit. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.  

​

SCHEDULE

Hospitality demands a flexible schedule that may require extended hours as the business requires coverage including seasonality– on any day at any hour, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive.  They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully.  The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time without prior notice. The Company will try to give as much notice as practical when changes are made.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you an engineering leader who's ready to build and scale a high-performing team — not just manage one?

We're running a confidential search for a Director of Engineering
to lead the engineering and drafting function for a precast concrete manufacturer that's part of a multi-billion-dollar, privately owned company based in the U.S. The role is based about 40 miles north of Orlando, FL, and supports engineering operations across multiple plants throughout the Southeast. Specific company details are shared directly with qualified candidates.

What makes this role worth a conversation:

This isn't just an engineering seat — it's a leadership mandate. You'll build the workflows, KPIs, and culture that let a growing engineering team punch above its weight, while staying hands-on with structural design and technical problem-solving.

What you'll own:

Lead and scale an integrated engineering and drafting team, aligning people, process, and workflow to hit throughput, quality, and service targets
Recruit, coach, and develop a strong bench of technical talent, with training and performance management tied to measurable outcomes
Partner directly with Regional Sales and Operations VPs to keep engineering capacity aligned with business needs
Own structural design and review for precast products, pipe, and fittings — keeping designs current with evolving codes and standards
Manage budgets, schedules, and priorities across a multi-plant portfolio
Be the technical go-to for sales teams, plant personnel, contractors, consulting engineers, and municipalities

What you bring:

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline
Active PE license (Florida preferred)
10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including 3+ years in a management role
A track record of building workflows, KPIs, and governance systems that actually move the needle on turnaround time, quality, and cross-functional alignment
Solid understanding of precast structural design, codes, and constructability
Comfort working in QPS, ERP, CRM, CAD, Power BI, or similar systems
Strong written and verbal communication skills, and a bias for action

Why it's worth a look:

Competitive six-figure salary (targeting 160,000 - 200,000 based on experience)
A genuine build-and-scale mandate, with real room to grow
Full benefits: health, dental, vision, and a 401(k) match
Paid vacation and holidays
Minimal travel — less than 10%

Interested, or know someone who'd be a great fit? Reach out confidentially to Jodi Harrison at jodi.harrison@fhrecruiting.com.

Primary responsibility for the safe and efficient organization and operation of the repairs and maintenance
department at the Planters Inn

for at least one other hotel in our portfolio, working closely with the onsite Engineering Manager and the General Manager to enhance building efficiency, minimize operational downtime and maintain rigorous compliance standards.

jobs.title: DMS Director, Engineering and Technical Services
jobs.description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

We are seeking a dynamic, collaborative, and high-performing Director, Engineering and Technical Services responsible for the technical assessment of assets (Aircraft, Engines, Airframes, APU, Landing Gear & Components). Accomplish Technical Reviews for the Acquisition of engines, APU, airframe and landing gear assemblies to comply with Delta maintenance program following TOPP procedures. Assist in managing engine records reviews, EIS (Engineering Information Summary) reviews and Lease Engine Management.

This position is based in Atlanta, GA and reports to Vice President – Acquisitions and Technical

Duties Include But Not Limited To

Reviewing and coordinating research and analysis of Delta Engineering configuration, DER repairs, Airworthiness Directives and producing EIS packages per applicable TOPP procedures with internal and external stakeholders.
The successful Technical Engineering Manager will support the Lease and Sales records tracking process and complete Engineering analysis and coordinate Delta TechOps Engineering Approvals for Acquisitions and CRF materials procured for Delta Airlines.
The ideal candidate must have the business acumen and technical intellect to collect, collaborate, communicate, analyze, and make decisions as appropriate, whether individually or within a team environment.
In this role, empowered to work directly with our internal and external stakeholders; SCM Acquisition team, Engineering, Fleet, Engine Maintenance, Supplier Operations, MRO and DMS to ensure delivery of reliable assets that support key operational and financial objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Manage Technical Reviews (TechFit) for the Acquisition and/or lease of engines, APU, airframe and landing gear assemblies to comply with Delta maintenance program following TOPP procedures. Collaborate with DTO Engineering and coordinate with Acquisitions and DMS teams to provide accurate assessments to bridge into the Delta fleet.
Manage EIS reviews and ensure assets that deliver meet TechOps “Entry into Service” (EIS) requirements per TechOps TOPP requirements.
Accomplish Critical Parts Release research to gain Delta Engineering approvals for material sourced on behalf of Delta; including Airworthiness Directives, DER Repairs and configuration data to meet Delta specific TechOps Configuration Specification Manuals (CSM).
Research Airworthiness Directives, Service Bulletins, DER/PMA databases, Illustrated Parts Catalog, Configuration Specifications to ensure material source approvals meet Delta TechOps configuration requirements.
Verify asset hardware configuration requirements, and prior repair approvals for material to meet engine thrust configurations. Validate appropriate market value of owned or procurable assets.
Review aircraft and engine configuration requirements for conformity to published technical specification and document any variances. Determine if aircraft or engines are equipped and in a condition that meets objectives for piece-part asset acquisition or disposition.
Must develop a thorough understanding of TechOps Policies and Procedures and FAA regulations as they relate to aircraft, engine and component acquisitions and sales.
Lead DMS maintenance records department, set and implement standards as needed.
Daily interaction with internal and external customers; including but not limited to Engineering, Records, Product Line Managers and Buyers, Acquisitions and Sales teams, Planning, Quality Assurance, and Compliance Services Management to support purchase and sale of DMS and Delta Air Lines assets.
Assist in other technical and records areas as assigned.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

Prior engineering experience required
Demonstrated track record of collaboration and developing relationships across diverse and highly effective teams
Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data
Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency
Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering preferred. Other technical engineering degrees, will be considered
Ability to communicate effectively across large organizations
Knowledge of engine green time evaluations and lease modeling (reserves, return conditions, cashflow, etc.)
Works well under pressure and able to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously
Highly effective written and verbal communicator
Problem solving, solution minded approach to collaboration
Proficient in use of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, TEAMS & Salesforce

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. In the Subsidiaries, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with the employees. Exploring a career within the Subsidiaries gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

Competitive salary, industry-leading performance incentives program
401(k) with generous company contributions up to 5%
Paid time off including holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts
Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and your dependents in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Delta perks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.description:
Transform healthcare with us.

At Qualified Health, we’re redefining what’s possible with Generative AI in healthcare. Our infrastructure provides the guardrails for safe AI governance, healthcare-specific agent creation, and real-time algorithm monitoring—working alongside leading health systems to drive real change.

This is more than just a job. It’s an opportunity to build the future of AI in healthcare, solve complex challenges, and make a lasting impact on patient care. If you’re ambitious, innovative, and ready to move fast, we’d love to have you on board.

Join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

Job Summary

Our engineering organization has tripled in size over a short period, and we are seeking a Director of Engineering to set the strategic direction and organizational structure for this next stage of growth demands. This is an engineering leadership role with ownership across our entire engineering organization — application scaling and delivery, new product development powered by cutting-edge AI and LLM methodologies, and our core platform.

The Director will lead through a team of technical leaders, shaping org-wide roadmap priorities, resourcing, and technical direction rather than running any single team day-to-day. This role is central to our value-based contracting strategy, working directly with senior leadership and major accounts to help realize and demonstrate substantial business value.

We are looking for a proven, sustained engineering leader with a track record of building and scaling engineering organizations and developing managers into stronger leaders.

Key Responsibilities

Own full people management responsibilities across your organization: performance reviews, conflict resolution, career progression, and hiring
Build and scale a high-performing engineering organization, growing headcount thoughtfully as the org expands
Drive the roadmap and delivery across the full engineering organization, including application scaling and delivery, new product development, and our core platform.
Guide the adoption of the latest LLM methodologies and applied AI techniques to solve some of the hardest, highest-impact problems in healthcare
Lead modernization of the platform to support a scaling application layer
Manage and develop the managers and functional leads across your organization
Partner with executive leadership to align roadmaps and priorities across Applications and Platform
Stay close enough to the technical work to make sound decisions and unblock your teams (~10%-50% hands-on), while spending the majority of your time on management and leadership
Support client accounts' engineering needs, helping the business prove out value-based contract commitments

Required Qualifications

10–15+ years of engineering experience, including sustained, 4+ years of ongoing experience as a people manager
Track record of growing a team from a small group to 10+ people
Experience managing 10–15+ engineers, either directly or through other managers
Demonstrated full-cycle people management skills: performance management, conflict resolution, and career development
Comfort with system design and architecture discussions; some hands-on coding ability is expected; high comfortability and expertise with system design
Strong technical breadth across backend engineering, applied AI/ML, and platform or distributed systems, with experience taking applications into production
Background as an engineering tech lead prior to transitioning into management

Desirable Skills

Experience at both a big tech company and a growth-stage startup
Prior experience leading engineering for a health-tech business (not required, but a plus)
Experience operating in value-based or outcomes-based contract environments
Familiarity with modern LLM tooling and methodologies
Experience partnering with account or business leadership on high-stakes, high-value client relationships

Why Join Qualified Health?

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing company and a world-class team, that is poised to change the healthcare industry. We are a passionate, mission-driven team that is building a category-defining product. We are backed by premier investors and are looking for founding team members who are excited to do the best work of their careers.

Our employees are integral to achieving our goals so we are proud to offer competitive salaries with equity packages, robust medical/dental/vision insurance, flexible working hours, hybrid work options and an inclusive environment that fosters creativity and innovation.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Qualified Health is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is essential to our success, and we are committed to building a team that reflects the world we live in. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Pay & Benefits:
The pay range for this role is between $240,000-$310,000, and will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

Join our mission to revolutionize healthcare with AI.
To apply, please send your resume through the application below.

Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

Fidelity Investments has a phenomenal opportunity for a Director, Engineering, to lead the Customer Protection and Digital Shared Services QE group! Including developing an automation roadmap, strategies, monitoring testing progress, providing automation KPIs to Engineering leaders and Product, project estimates/resource assignments and relationship management with development/business partners. This includes automation analysis/evaluation, automation approach, test scenarios, overseeing multiple projects, leading/supporting the design/development and execution of both test cases/scripts, monitoring first-level triage of defects found, and ensuring thorough retesting of defects through resolution occurs. This role will be based in Westlake, TX.

The Expertise You Have

Bachelor’s degree in computer science preferred; a degree in Engineering or Math is acceptable with comparable software development experience.
10 years of software development or test automation experience.
Experience in Financial Services, specifically in DC or DB. Digital products such as NetBenefits, NB Mobile and PSW product area are a plus.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build and maintain strong multi-functional partnerships and relationships at all levels of the organization
Deep technical expertise with confirmed ability to drive technical solutions and automation frameworks/pipelines such as Selenium, Playwright, Rest Assured, Karate, etc.
Work closely with product owners on blueprints and quarterly planning on feature sets that impact multiple clients and products.
Uses a data-focused approach to decision making, in day-to-day leadership and strategic tradeoff analyses
Practical experience with quality engineering fundamentals such as test automation, data virtualization, and CI/CD integration
Authentic investment in implementing and sustaining quality gates with an audit and governance approach
Proactively partner with Engineering partners, COE teams, and Product Managers to:
influence strategic backlog and prioritization decisions related to your area of expertise
measure performance through established objectives and critical metrics and deliver agreed upon business, technology, and people results
align associates across teams and product areas to ensure the best utilization of talent while also building learning opportunities and content to develop skills
set and apply standards and ensure the work performed is aligned with established road maps

An intellectual curiosity and passion to learn new skills and modeling a culture of continuous learning, mentoring, and coaching
Experience resource planning and talent allocation across large organizations

The Value You Deliver

Leading the team to revitalize test automation effort to reduce testing cycle time significantly while increasing test coverage.
Imagine. Innovate. Inspire. Keep it cool: Cultivate an inclusive organizational culture, champion positive energy and family spirit, recognize greatness, support each other and enjoy the journey.
Supporting Engineering delivery teams to achieve faster delivery speed, collaborating with development and DevOps engineers.

Plan, coordinate and work with partners to create team capacity to achieve the revitalization goal.
Work with other QE lead/teams to use and reuse existing automation dashboard and methodology and strive to improve

The Workplace Investing Quality Engineering team is seeking a multifaceted, forward thinking organizational leader who is passionate about the customer and committed to quality. Strategic mentality coupled with technical competence of Quality practices drives our ideal candidate toward execution and delivery, while they lead a distributed team of Quality Engineers.

jobs.title: Vice President – Lead Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About This Role

About this role

Vice President – Lead Platform Engineer

The Vice President – Lead Platform Engineer will drive the strategy, architecture, and delivery of next-generation engineering capabilities on Aladdin. This role is responsible for building scalable, governed, and event-driven data ecosystems that power investment, analytics, and reporting platforms with high-quality, near real-time data.

Role Overview

Lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade platforms that will act as building blocks for the rest of the business.
Champion modern architecture patterns, including event-driven and streaming frameworks.
Establish and enforce platform-as-a-product principles, and governance frameworks.
Serve as a senior technical leader partnering across engineering, product, and platform organizations.
Key Responsibilities
Define and execute the data platform engineering strategy around event-driven systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Lead development of event-driven architectures leveraging streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka) and modern processing frameworks.
Establish robust data governance, quality, lineage, and observability practices across the platform.
Partner with cross-functional teams to align platform capabilities with business and investment use cases.
Promote engineering excellence through CI/CD, automation, and standardized development practices.
Leadership & Impact
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and direction to high-performing engineering teams.
Influence enterprise architecture and platform strategy decisions.
Drive adoption of scalable, reusable, and standardized solutions across the organization.
Ensure alignment between platform engineering initiatives and business outcomes, particularly in financial services and investment domains.

Qualifications

Extensive experience in platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern event-driven solutions (e.g., Kafka).
Strong expertise in programming (Python, Java, or Scala).
Proven track record of building and scaling production-grade platforms.
Experience with streaming and event-driven architecture.
Prior experience in financial services or asset management preferred.

For New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$162,000.00 - USD$215,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

jobs.description:
Vice President, Payments Engineering

Business Title:
VP, Payments Engineering

Reports to:
SVP, Global Product Engineering

Build the Next Generation of Payments at WEX

Overview

Payments are at the heart of commerce, and the industry is undergoing one of its most significant transformations in decades. Real-time payments, embedded finance, intelligent automation, AI-native software development, cloud platforms, and evolving customer expectations are fundamentally changing how businesses move money.

At WEX, we're building the next generation of Payments solutions through our next generation business, product and technology transformation strategy, that helps modernize into a common, intelligent payments platform that powers businesses around the world.

This is not a traditional engineering leadership role.

This is an opportunity to lead one of the most strategic technology transformations at WEX. As Vice President of Payments Engineering,
you will lead a world-class global engineering organization responsible for delivering secure, scalable, cloud-native payment platforms while helping redefine how software is built in the era of AI.

You will partner closely with Product, Architecture, Commercial leaders, and the Payments Technology Leader to transform complex business challenges into exceptional customer experiences and industry-leading payment capabilities.

If you are passionate about payments, modern engineering, AI-native software development, and building high-performing engineering organizations, we'd love to talk with you.

About The Role

The Vice President of Payments Engineering is responsible for leading the engineering organization that delivers WEX's Payments platform.

You will lead multiple global engineering teams responsible for designing, building, and operating mission-critical payment systems that process billions of dollars in transactions while maintaining the highest standards of availability, security, scalability, and customer trust.

Success in this role requires equal strength in technology leadership, engineering execution, organizational leadership, and business partnership.

You will be responsible for transforming engineering practices through AI-native software development while delivering predictable business outcomes and accelerating WEX's modernization journey.

What You'll Do

Lead World-Class Engineering Organizations

Lead multiple global software engineering teams responsible for Payments platforms and services.
Build an engineering culture focused on innovation, accountability, operational excellence, and continuous learning.
Attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent.
Coach engineering leaders and build a strong leadership pipeline.

Deliver Critical Business Outcomes

Own engineering delivery for Payments initiatives.
Translate technology strategy into executable roadmaps.
Deliver predictable, high-quality software that meets customer and business commitments.
Drive engineering execution across multiple product domains and shared platform capabilities.
Partner with Product and Technology leadership to balance customer value, delivery speed, and technical sustainability.

Drive AI-Native Software Engineering

This is one of the most important aspects of the role.

We believe AI will fundamentally reshape software engineering.

You will lead the adoption of AI-native engineering practices across the software development lifecycle, including:

AI-assisted software design
AI-powered coding
Intelligent testing automation
AI-driven code reviews
Automated documentation
AI-enabled operational excellence
Developer productivity platforms
Agentic software engineering

You'll help define how engineering teams build software in the next decade.

Build Modern Payments Platforms

Lead Engineering For Highly Available Payment Platforms Supporting

Virtual Payments
Accounts Payable
Payment orchestration
Payment processing
Embedded Payments
Treasury and settlement
Commercial card platforms
API-first payment capabilities

Develop highly scalable cloud-native systems capable of supporting enterprise customers around the world.

Partner Across the Business

This role requires exceptional collaboration.

You Will Partner Closely With

Product Leadership
Payments Technology Leadership
Commercial teams
Enterprise Architecture
Security
Operations
Customer Success
Finance
External partners

You should be equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, delivery commitments with Product, and customer outcomes with executives.

Modernize Through

Help Drive WEX's Transformation By

Building reusable payment capabilities
Accelerating platform convergence
Improving engineering productivity
Reducing technical debt
Standardizing engineering practices
Driving cloud modernization
Enabling intelligent automation

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a technology leader who combines deep engineering expertise with strong payments and business acumen.

The ideal candidate has successfully led large engineering organizations while modernizing complex payment platforms and delivering transformational business outcomes.

You are comfortable operating at both the executive and technical levels, able to discuss platform architecture with distinguished engineers one moment and business strategy with executive leadership the next.

Qualifications

Required

20+ years of software engineering experience with at least 12 years leading large engineering organizations.
Significant experience building modern payment systems, financial platforms, or other highly regulated transaction-processing platforms.
Deep understanding of payments, including authorization, settlement, reconciliation, treasury, commercial payments, payment networks, APIs, and payment operations.
Proven experience delivering cloud-native distributed systems at enterprise scale.
Strong technical background across modern architectures, microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, Kubernetes, public cloud, observability, resilience, and security.
Demonstrated success leading organizational transformation.
Strong software delivery track record with predictable execution across multiple teams.
Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations.
Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred

Experience at a leading payments or fintech company.
Experience building AI-native engineering organizations.
Experience implementing AI-assisted software development tools.
Experience modernizing legacy platforms.
Experience with platform engineering and developer productivity.
Experience leading large-scale cloud migrations.
MBA or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Leadership Characteristics

The Successful Candidate Will Be

A Builder: Creates exceptional engineering organizations that consistently deliver customer value.

A Technologist: Brings deep technical credibility and earns the respect of senior engineers.

A Payments Expert: Understands how modern payment ecosystems operate and anticipates industry evolution.

AI-Native: Sees AI not as a feature, but as the future operating model for software engineering.

A Business Partner: Builds trusted relationships across Product, Commercial, and Technology while keeping customer outcomes at the center of every decision.

A Transformation Leader: Thrives in ambiguity, embraces change, and inspires teams through large-scale modernization.

A Talent Multiplier: Develops future leaders and creates an environment where engineers can do the best work of their careers.

Why Join WEX?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Payments at one of the industry's leading financial technology companies.

You'll help define the next generation of intelligent payment platforms, lead the adoption of AI-native software engineering, and influence how modern financial technology is built at enterprise scale.

If you're energized by solving complex engineering challenges, passionate about payments, and excited by the opportunity to build the future, not simply maintain the present, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Object Storage - DGX Cloud
jobs.description:
NVIDIA's Object Storage Platform team builds and operates the company's internal S3-compatible distributed object storage service — a critical piece of infrastructure that stores, manages, and serves exabytes of data across NVIDIA's on-premises and hybrid environments. This platform is the storage backbone for NVIDIA's AI infrastructure, enabling researchers and engineers to reliably store massive datasets, model checkpoints, and training artifacts at scale. A companion data movement team extends the platform with tooling that efficiently stages and moves data closer to GPU clusters, minimizing idle accelerator time and accelerating training and inference pipelines.

We are seeking a seasoned Engineering Manager to lead this organization across two closely aligned teams: the core Object Storage platform team and the Data Movement Tools team. You will own the full software development and service delivery lifecycle — from roadmap planning through production operations — while building a high-performance engineering culture grounded in technical excellence, service reliability, and continuous delivery.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead and grow a multi-team engineering organization, setting a high bar for software quality, service reliability, and engineering culture.
Own roadmap execution for NVIDIA's internal object storage service — partnering with internal customers, Product Management, and Architecture to translate multi-quarter goals into clear engineering plans with measurable milestones.
Drive development and operation of NVIDIA's S3-compatible object storage service, ensuring it meets the performance, durability, availability, and scalability demands of AI training and inference workloads at exabyte scale.
Lead the Data Movement Tools team in building and evolving tooling that stages datasets, model checkpoints, and artifacts from distributed storage to GPU-adjacent compute — minimizing I/O bottlenecks and keeping accelerators fully utilized.
Define and uphold service reliability standards: SLOs, capacity planning, incident response, root cause analysis, and on-call hygiene. Partner with SRE to ensure the platform meets the availability commitments internal customers depend on.
Establish and enforce engineering standards across both teams: design reviews, code quality, CI/CD practices, automated testing, and production observability. Recruit, mentor, and develop engineers across all levels, conducting regular 1:1s, performance cycles, and career growth conversations. Build a diverse, inclusive, and high-retention team.
Collaborate closely with SRE, Platform, Networking, and Security teams to ensure smooth transitions from development to production and rapid resolution of customer-impacting issues.
Champion the adoption of AI-assisted development tooling — coding assistants, agentic workflows, and automated testing harnesses — to accelerate team productivity and raise engineering output. Represent the Object Storage engineering organization to senior leadership, providing transparent status updates, surfacing risks early, and advocating for the resources needed to succeed.

What We Need To See

BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.
10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in an engineering management role leading teams of 10 or more engineers delivering production services at scale.
Deep technical background in distributed storage systems, object storage platforms, or large-scale cloud data services; hands-on development experience in Go, C++, Python, or equivalent systems languages.
Direct, hands-on experience building or scaling S3-compatible object storage systems in a production cloud or private cloud environment — with demonstrable improvements in throughput, durability, or operational efficiency.
Demonstrated experience building or operating cloud storage services — with accountability for reliability, performance, and capacity at scale in a production environment.
Proven track record of shipping production software on time — managing scope, risk, and delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams.
Strong experience with modern software development and service delivery practices: CI/CD, automated testing, SLO-based reliability, production observability, and incident management.
Demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and retain strong engineering talent in a driven environment, with a track record of growing engineers into senior and staff-level roles.
Excellent written and verbal communication — able to translate complex technical trade-offs for product partners and engineering constraints for executive audiences.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Prior experience designing and operating internal cloud storage services (IaaS/PaaS) with well-defined SLAs, metered usage, and internal customer-facing APIs.
Background in data movement, data staging, or prefetching tooling for AI/ML workloads — with direct experience optimizing data pipelines to reduce GPU idle time during training or inference.
Familiarity with AI infrastructure storage patterns: checkpoint storage, dataset versioning, write-once-read-many (WORM) access patterns, or storage-aware scheduling at 10k+ GPU scale. Experience managing capacity planning, cost optimization, and chargeback modeling for shared internal storage infrastructure.
Track record of adopting AI-assisted development tools to meaningfully improve team productivity, with concrete examples. History of growing engineers into senior ICs or leads, and building diverse, inclusive teams with strong retention.

NVIDIA's Object Storage Platform and data movement tooling form a critical layer in keeping NVIDIA's GPU fleet productive — every model trained, every checkpoint saved, and every dataset staged passes through the systems this team builds and operates. This is a high-impact role at the center of NVIDIA's AI infrastructure.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4, and 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 27, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description:

Manufacturing & Operations

Operations Management

Job Description:

The Engineering and Technical Operations Senior Manager is responsible to provide leadership, technical expertise and drive results across capital execution, site and facility maintenance, asset and productivity improvements while managing and minimizing labor & overhead costs while ensuring the highest levels of safety, quality, sanitation and regulatory compliance.

This position will be onsite at our Monett, MO location.

Relocating candidates (50+ miles) are eligible for $10,000 relocation bonus

What you’ll do:

Ensures mechanical and electrical expertise are available to production and other departments to maintain production systems, utilities, buildings and grounds in a 24-hour, 7-day per week operation.
Drive key initiatives around the standardization of “best practices” and policies for the Maintenance Department
Provide leadership and direction to plant maintenance function covering the 24/7 operation
Improve employee safety, production quality, equipment reliability, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) utilizing Continuous Improvement techniques
Utilizes mechanical and electrical expertise to manage production systems, utilities, buildings and grounds
Full knowledge and utilization of the EAM system in support of maintenance & engineering functions
Responsible for Continuous Improvement programs related to engineering, to generate improvement plans that feature both short and long-term improvements, with and without capital investment.
Business driver of Value Stream Mapping and Lean Processes
Drive key initiatives throughout the facility in the areas of Maintenance, fixed asset management, plant layout & flow manufacturing, managing floating bottlenecks, FDA/GMP/AIB compliance, safety and automation
Train staff members on new technologies (electrical controls, and other manufacturing technology).
Maintenance Mechanic(s), Maintenance Planner) directly and/or indirectly, to ensure effective selection, retention, development, disciplinary action and performance management.
If a collective bargaining agreement exists, may participate in negotiations, grievances or other contract related activities and discussions.
Drive key initiatives around refrigeration systems, plant utility systems, high-speed processing, and packaging/material handling systems
Together with the leadership team, ensures compliance with Food Safety and Food Quality Plans, in addition to customer requirements. Interprets and communicates customer requirements to plant production and/or support groups. Establishes and Audits PCPs, CCPs and Standard Operating Procedures to define and monitor processes, to ensure customer requirements are met. Reviews incidents during which the procedures are not met, and determines appropriate corrective action for partners failing to follow standard procedures.

What you need to succeed:

Bachelors in Engineering or related field
5-10 years of experience in Engineering, Project Management, Process Excellence, Black Belt or Maintenance.
8-10 years’ progressive experience in manufacturing engineering, with at least 5 years in a management role
Extensive knowledge of operations from a technical perspective (Green Belt/Black Belt preferred).
High level management and business skills, extensive financial knowledge base as well as understanding of employment policies/procedures.
Organizational, interpersonal, communication and conflict resolution skills
Effectively communicate concepts both verbally and in writing
Able to influence and impact all levels in the organization

jobs.title: Director, Product Development - MCP Platform & Agent Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Job Description

About American Express Digital Labs

American Express Digital Labs catalyzes digital innovation across the enterprise by originating, incubating, and scaling products and platforms that matter to our customers’ digital lives. We combine creativity, customer centricity, and technical excellence to reimagine how Card Members experience payments and membership in a digital world.

As a fast-moving, entrepreneurial team, we partner with leading technology companies and strategic partners to bring differentiated digital payment solutions and engaging membership experiences to market.

Role Overview

As Director, Product Development – MCP Platform & Agent Ecosystem, you will define and lead the platform strategy that enables Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and external AI platforms to securely access American Express capabilities through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). This role will help establish how American Express participates in the rapidly evolving agent ecosystem while creating reusable foundations that power AI experiences across both external platforms and American Express digital channels.

You will own the core MCP platform, standards, and operating model that enable product teams across the company to expose capabilities in a secure, scalable, and consistent manner. Working closely with MCP use case teams and business owners, you will define best practices for tool design, authentication, authorization, documentation, evaluation, observability, personalization, and responsible AI governance. As the company’s MCP subject matter expert, you will build a center of excellence that accelerates adoption while ensuring a high bar for quality, security, compliance, and customer experience.

Success in this role requires a unique blend of platform product management, AI fluency, developer experience expertise, ecosystem thinking, and strong cross-functional leadership.

Responsibilities

Define and Lead MCP Platform Strategy

Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the American Express MCP platform.
Define the foundational capabilities required to expose American Express services to external LLMs, AI assistants, agent platforms, and internal AI experiences.
Establish platform standards, governance models, and operating principles for MCP adoption across the enterprise.
Drive alignment across engineering, architecture, security, risk, compliance, privacy, and product teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities.
Evaluate emerging MCP standards, agent ecosystems, and industry developments to continuously evolve the platform strategy.

Build the MCP Center of Excellence

Serve as the company-wide expert on MCP architecture, implementation patterns, and agent integration best practices.
Develop frameworks, guidance, and reusable patterns that enable teams to build high-quality MCP capabilities consistently.
Define standards for tool design, metadata structures, descriptions, prompts, schemas, and agent interactions.
Establish governance processes that ensure MCP capabilities are discoverable, maintainable, and optimized for AI consumption.
Drive education, enablement, and adoption efforts across product and engineering organizations.

Define Developer Experience and Integration Standards

Own the MCP developer experience for both internal and external consumers.
Establish documentation standards, onboarding experiences, reference architectures, SDK requirements, and integration frameworks.
Define how developers, partners, and AI platforms discover, authenticate, and integrate with American Express MCP capabilities.
Lead experimentation with emerging integration models, including web-based MCP architectures and next-generation agent connectivity patterns.
Drive continuous improvements to usability, adoption, and integration success rates.

Define Platform Foundations, Security, and Governance

Partner with security, identity, and platform engineering teams to define authentication and authorization models for MCP-enabled experiences.
Establish standards for OAuth, consent management, permissioning , access controls, and customer data protection.
Define scalable approaches for customer identity resolution, authorization management, and secure agent interactions.
Establish product principles and governance frameworks that define how American Express data, services, and customer information may be accessed and utilized by LLMs and AI agents.
Partner with legal, compliance, privacy, risk, and data governance teams to ensure platform capabilities align with regulatory requirements, customer expectations, and company policies.
Define standards for data minimization, consent, transparency, attribution, and appropriate AI usage.
Drive platform capabilities that enable policy enforcement, auditability, and governance across agent interactions.

Establish Quality, Evaluation, Analytics, and Observability Frameworks

Define evaluation methodologies to assess MCP tool quality, usability, discoverability, reliability, and effectiveness.
Develop measurement frameworks that assess how well tools perform across various LLMs, agent platforms, and use cases.
Partner with data science and analytics teams to establish KPIs, reporting, and performance monitoring capabilities.
Lead the development of platform-wide observability, telemetry, debugging, and monitoring solutions.
Drive continuous improvement through experimentation, measurement, and iterative optimization.

Build Personalization and Intelligence Foundations

Define platform capabilities that enable personalization and contextual intelligence across AI-enabled experiences.
Partner with data, AI, and product teams to establish reusable customer context, preference, and memory frameworks.
Identify opportunities to improve agent effectiveness through shared context and personalization services.
Ensure personalization capabilities are implemented responsibly and align with privacy and regulatory requirements.

Partner Across Product and Engineering Organizations

Collaborate closely with MCP use case teams and business owners responsible for building individual customer experiences and MCP tools.
Provide consultation, architectural guidance, and platform support throughout the product development lifecycle.
Influence roadmaps across multiple organizations to ensure consistency and alignment with platform standards.
Work closely with engineering leaders to prioritize investments that maximize platform adoption and long-term scalability.
Build strong relationships across product, engineering, architecture, security, risk, legal, and operations teams.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of product management experience, with significant experience leading platform, API, developer platform, or infrastructure products.
Proven experience defining product strategy and delivering large-scale platform capabilities across multiple stakeholder groups.
Experience building developer-facing products, APIs, SDKs, or ecosystem platforms.
Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, identity, OAuth, consent management, platform security, and data governance concepts.
Experience working across legal, compliance, privacy, and risk stakeholders to launch customer-facing platform capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in highly cross-functional environments and influence without direct authority.
Experience defining product metrics, experimentation frameworks, and data-driven decision-making processes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, agentic systems, MCP, function calling, tool orchestration, or related technologies.
Experience building products for developer ecosystems, partner integrations, marketplaces, or platform businesses.
Knowledge of MCP standards, agent frameworks, AI tooling ecosystems, and emerging industry patterns.
Experience defining AI governance, responsible AI controls, model evaluation frameworks, or AI platform standards.
Experience defining observability, telemetry, monitoring, analytics, or platform measurement capabilities.
Familiarity with personalization platforms, customer context systems, conversational AI experiences, or AI-driven recommendation capabilities.
Experience partnering with security, identity, privacy, and enterprise architecture organizations on platform-scale initiatives.
Experience leading products in highly regulated industries such as financial services, payments, fintech, or technology.
Advanced degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data Products
jobs.description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our Data Products pillar, serving as the technical engine for Counterpart Health's (CPH) clinical-data foundation. You will own the technical strategy and execution for the Data Products roadmap—encompassing clinical data ingestion, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability—while building scalable, reusable data capabilities that serve as a foundational platform for driving clinical insight generation. You will own the technical strategy for our Data Products platform—ensuring our clinical data foundations (using standards like FHIR, LOINC, and RxNorm) effectively drive business outcomes. You will serve as a critical leader and partner to the VP of Engineering and cross-functional leaders in Product, Data Science, and Design.

As a Director Of Engineering, Data Products, You Will

Own the Data Products technical roadmap, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability.
Manage and optimize the clinical data ingestion pipeline.
Oversee the scaling of customer data onboarding processes and the continuous improvement of data hygiene, canonical storage standards, and observability and monitoring of the data pipelines.
Enable shared funnel visibility across the organization and support the development of a robust enterprise reporting framework.
Drive the adoption of an AI-powered Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), leveraging AI tools to accelerate coding, testing, and deployment processes while maintaining stringent code quality and security standards.

Success In This Role Looks Like

Successfully achieving improved clinical data coverage and freshness targets across all patient populations.
Predictable and repeatable multi-customer scaling with standardized playbooks for rapid data readiness.
Broad adoption of the Data Products platform and its capabilities
Data infrastructure is robust, stable, and serves as a reliable source of truth during rapid organizational growth and customer expansion.

You Should Get In Touch If

You possess 10+ years of engineering experience with a deep focus on building high-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR, CCDA).
Proven track record in managing and scaling engineering teams that handle data-heavy workloads and complex clinical data pipelines.
Proven experience leading cross-functional teams of engineers to deliver complex software in regulated environments.
Experience implementing and scaling AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., AI code assistants, automated testing, or AI-driven SDLC) to improve engineering productivity.
Demonstrated experience building and managing engineering systems in highly regulated healthcare environments, with a strong operational understanding of HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance requirements.
Passionate about the healthcare sector and committed to utilizing technical expertise to drive meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.
Deeply familiar with the inherent complexities and lack of standardization in clinical datasets, with a proactive focus on enhancing data integrity.
Motivated by intricate technical challenges and dedicated to architecting pragmatic, high-quality engineering solutions through continuous intellectual exploration.
Thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments, demonstrating the ability to navigate ambiguity and align technical priorities with overarching strategic objectives.
Action-oriented leader who assumes full ownership of system sustainability, willing to address operational gaps to ensure the team achieves its delivery milestones.

Engineering Leadership Skills

Proven track record of directly hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering managers, Tech Leads (TLs), and Principal Engineers (PELs).
Demonstrated ability to cultivate a high-performance engineering culture focused on velocity, quality, and psychological safety.
Experience leading organizational change, including structural re-orgs and process evolution.
Strong proficiency in strategic resource allocation, capacity planning, and managing technical debt in a fast-paced product environment.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear, actionable business strategies (e.g., impact on HEDIS/RADV outcomes) for non-technical leadership.

Benefits Overview

Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
Professional Development: We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks

Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
Paid parental leave for all new parents
And much more!

In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Vice President AI/ML Software Engineer

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators and champions of inclusion, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President AI/ML Software Engineer
to lead the architecture and delivery of production-grade AI systems built on agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLM orchestration. This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for a team of engineers building autonomous AI pipelines that extract, validate, and reason over complex unstructured documents. You will own the technical vision for a multi-agent ecosystem -- designing pipeline orchestration engines, embedding/vectorization strategies, knowledge retrieval systems, and AI-assisted code generation tooling. You will lead a VP-level engineer and a broader team of 4-8 developers. This role is in New York, NY

What Sets This Role Apart
- You build the agent framework, not just configure one -- custom orchestration engine, not a LangChain wrapper - Production AI with real consequences -- extraction accuracy directly impacts financial operations - Full RAG ownership -- from raw OCR bytes through embedding, retrieval, and generation - Evaluation-driven culture -- golden-truth datasets, automated regression, measurable quality gates - Greenfield AI + enterprise integration -- build new AI-native systems that plug into established platforms

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to impact on our organization in the following ways:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Architect agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning/reasoning loops, and autonomous decision chains - Design and evolve RAG infrastructure -- chunking strategies, embedding pipelines, vector store selection, retrieval ranking, and context window optimization - Define vectorization strategy: embedding model selection, dimensionality trade-offs, hybrid search (dense + sparse), and re-ranking approaches - Own the AI pipeline orchestration framework -- blocks, inlets/outlets, blackboards, memory stores, and content policy enforcement - Make build-vs-buy decisions across the AI toolchain (vector databases, agent frameworks, evaluation harnesses, model gateways) - Establish patterns for prompt engineering at scale: prompt versioning, chain-of-thought decomposition, few-shot management, and guardrails

Agentic & RAG Systems

Design multi-agent architectures with shared memory, blackboard patterns, and inter-agent communication protocols - Build autonomous extraction agents capable of planning, tool selection, self-correction, and validation - Implement knowledge graph construction from unstructured documents -- entity extraction, relationship mapping, and graph-based retrieval - Develop evaluation frameworks: retrieval precision/recall, extraction accuracy, agent task completion rates, and hallucination detection - Design feedback loops: human-in-the-loop correction, reinforcement from golden-truth datasets, and continuous prompt refinement

Team Leadership

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 4-8 engineers (AI/ML, backend, full-stack) - Directly manage a VP-level AI engineer; provide technical guidance and career development - Drive architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical decision-making - Own sprint planning, technical backlog, and delivery commitments - Foster a culture of rapid experimentation balanced with production rigor

Hands-On Engineering -

Implement core agentic components: agent loops, tool registries, memory persistence, and reasoning traces - Build embedding pipelines -- document preprocessing, chunk boundary detection, metadata enrichment, and vector index management - Develop scoring and validation systems (Bayesian confidence, cross-agent consensus, golden-truth comparison) - Contribute to platform services (Java/Spring Boot) and AI service layer (Python/FastAPI) - Build AI-assisted developer tooling: code generation workflows, automated test generation, and intelligent code review

Delivery & Operations

Own CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, and environment promotion - Define observability: agent execution traces, token usage tracking, retrieval quality metrics, and pipeline telemetry - Manage schema evolution and data stores (relational + vector) - Coordinate cross-team dependencies with platform engineering, data engineering, and infrastructure

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Bachelor's degree or Advanced degree in computer science engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required. 10+ years of professional software engineering experience - 3+ years leading or technically mentoring engineering teams - Deep expertise in AI/ML systems: - LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, chain-of-thought reasoning - RAG architectures: chunking, embedding, retrieval, re-ranking, context assembly - Agentic patterns: ReAct, tool-use, planning loops, multi-agent coordination - Vector databases and embedding models (OpenAI embeddings, sentence-transformers, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar) - Strong Python (3.11+): FastAPI, async/await, Poetry, Pydantic, pytest - Solid Java experience: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, microservice architecture - Production AI delivery: not just prototypes -- systems handling real workloads with observability, error recovery, and audit trails - Document intelligence: OCR pipelines, NLP, structured extraction from unstructured text - Testing & evaluation: golden-truth validation, retrieval metrics (MRR, NDCG), extraction F1 scores, agent success rates - Enterprise architecture: API design, circuit breakers, caching, event-driven patterns

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building custom agent frameworks (not just using LangChain/CrewAI out-of-the-box) - Knowledge of graph-based retrieval -- knowledge graphs, graph RAG, entity-relationship extraction - Experience with code AI: AI-assisted development tools, code generation pipelines, automated refactoring - Familiarity with model fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, or RLHF techniques - Exposure to evaluation-driven development -- automated prompt regression testing, A/B testing of retrieval strategies - Angular/TypeScript experience for full-stack visibility - Capital markets or financial services domain knowledge - Familiarity with enterprise AI governance: content policies, PII handling, data residency

Technology Stack

AI/Agentic-
LLM orchestration, multi-agent systems, ReAct patterns, tool-use, autonomous pipelines

RAG & Vectors-
Embedding models, vector stores, hybrid search, re-ranking, chunk optimization

LLM-
Azure OpenAI, GPT-4o, enterprise model gateways, prompt versioning

Python-
Python 3.12/3.13, FastAPI, Poetry, Pydantic, async pipelines

Java-
Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, Maven, Resilience4j, Hazelcast

Frontend-
Angular 19, TypeScript, D3.js, ECharts

Database-
Oracle, PostgreSQL, vector databases

Infrastructure-
Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Artifactory

Observability-
Agent traces, token tracking, retrieval quality metrics, audit pipelines

jobs.description:
Overview

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.

Bring your whole self.

The Role and Team

The Head of Data Platform & Engineering owns our internal enterprise data strategy and platform, turning raw operational data into governed, trusted data products that power decision-making for our executive leadership team (ELT), FP&A, GTM Analytics and other business functions within Medallia. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with demonstrated experience in defining a data strategy, executing on the platform architecture and data modeling, and building and coaching a small team of data engineers and analysts. This role will also lead the effort to extend self-service analytics beyond a small group of expert Tableau users to a broader, distributed set of business analysts by leveraging the newer breed of analytics solutions and AI.

This role sits at the center of how we operate as one integrated, high-performing company: the data platform is the connective tissue that gives leadership a single source of truth on the health of the business, and gives go-to-market teams (Marketing, Sales, Service, and Support) the insight they need to protect and grow our customer base.

Responsibilities

Own and evolve the enterprise data strategy and technical architecture for the enterprise data platform, continuing our shift to a Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture.
Build a deep working knowledge of the company's GTM strategy, product telemetry, and financial reporting needs; act as a trusted advisor to business functions, translating their priorities into well-governed data products and a prioritized roadmap.
Partner with business function leaders and their distributed analytics teams to gather requirements, prioritize the backlog, and run an agile delivery model with a clear bias to action.
Provide hands-on leadership and coaching to a small team of data engineers and analysts, reviewing data models and pipelines and unblocking technical decisions.
Define and maintain data governance standards — quality, access, lineage, and shared definitions — in partnership with data owners across the business.
Lead the evaluation and rollout of tools that extend self-service analytics and AI enablement to non-technical business users, reducing reliance on multiple Excel workbooks and avoiding the learning curve of more complex BI solutions.
Partner cross-functionally on data initiatives that support revenue growth: pipeline generation, prospecting, expansion and renewal (ATR) opportunities, rep productivity, and product telemetry - bringing greater predictability and insight to the business.
Lead the selection, implementation, and management of the core data platform technology stack; partner with business functions on selection and management of the analytics and visualization tools that leverage the data platform.
Identify opportunities to apply AI to the data platform itself and to internal reporting and analytics workflows, in line with the company's broader AI-enablement priorities.

Candidates based in the Tysons vicinity will be prioritized as this role is Hybrid, 3 days per week onsite.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years in data engineering and/or data platform management, including 5+ years leading a data platform, data engineering, and/or analytics team.
Hands-on experience and proficiency in SQL and dbt (or a comparable transformation and orchestration solution) to transform raw source data into analysis-ready, governed tables and views.
Demonstrated experience architecting and operating cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse) at enterprise scale, leveraging pipeline orchestration (e.g., Dagster, Airflow, or similar) and EL / ETL tooling (e.g., Fivetran or similar).
Experience designing and executing a data platform strategy end to end — from technical architecture, through data governance, to business adoption.
Track record of translating ambiguous business requirements into clear data models, metrics, and reporting.
Experience running an agile delivery model with a bias to action and a track record of shipping incremental business value.
Strong communication, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills; comfortable operating as a trusted advisor to executive and business-function leaders, not just a service provider, in a dynamic environment.
Proven people leadership: hiring, coaching, and developing a small, senior technical team.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with a Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) or similar layered data architecture.
Experience with Tableau and with newer spreadsheet-native, self-service BI tools (e.g., Sigma, Omni) — particularly in extending BI to non-technical business analysts.
Familiarity with native AI/ML capabilities within a cloud data platform (e.g., Snowflake Cortex) and a passion for leveraging AI to accelerate data engineering and analytics work.
Experience in a B2B software/SaaS company, ideally supporting FP&A, GTM (marketing, sales, service/support), and executive data and reporting use cases.
Ability to distill signal from noise in large, messy data sets and crisply communicate the "so what" to non-technical executive audiences.
